paper_results/data/APPLICATION_QUALITY_C.observation_unit: method/model/filter/cohort aggregate; ALL_512 and TIMED_128 remain distinct

paper_results/data/QUERY_GAIN_7032_CURRE.observation_unit: configuration-specific query, averaged over predicates and runs

run_labels.run_id: Stable anonymous model-run label or the recorded aggregate/not-applicable description.
run_labels.source_run_id: Original per-observation run identifier, retained as an anonymous label when the source also had a model-level run field.
run_labels.run_counts: Fields named runs/model_runs and counts with run in their names retain the original repetition counts.
run_labels.run_sd: Recorded standard deviation across model runs; not a confidence interval.

data/QUERY_GAIN_7032_CURRENT.csv.unit: configuration-specific query averaged over predicates and model runs

data/SELECTIVITY_480_CURRENT.csv.min_max: pointwise range across three runs, not a confidence interval

application.TIMED_128: 128-query timing subset of the shared 512-query cohort
application.cost_percentiles: recorded pooled request-time percentile definitions are retained per row

tables.recall_coverage_and_recovery: percent unless the column specifies another unit
tables.blank_group_labels: blank dataset cells inherit the preceding displayed dataset
tables.table_03_effort_superscripts: P: original effort target reached; F: target not reached; A: automatic effort. These mark original search-effort status, not current coverage.
tables.dagger: CPU2 observation; unmarked development cost rows use CPU6
tables.table_05_notes: Saved cohort sizes, candidate coverage, predicate count, and query-group decrease percentages from the fixed-code comparison notes. Decrease percentages compare Full against the stated decoder.

measurement_conventions.missing: Empty cells retain unrecorded metadata and are not zero.
measurement_conventions.data_roles: Recorded evidence_role/data_role/role and protocol fields remain distinct.
